description: Parse a dbt model's SQL and generate a schema.yml with not_null tests for every selected column. When a dbt model needs baseline tests generated from its SQL. Do not choose this when the model uses jinja or macros a textual parse cannot resolve. Example requests: Generate dbt tests for this model. | Write a schema.yml for my dbt model. | Add not_null tests to this dbt model's columns.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

model_sql.description: The customer's model.sql, as text. Supported: SQL text. The dbt model SQL. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

profiles.description: The customer's profiles.json, as text. Supported: JSON. The dbt profiles file. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_dbt_test_generation

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.

title: dbt test generation
